sortable.$description: Sortable: items put in order by dragging; a line where a drop would land, a copy after the pointer.

container.$description: The list of items: `target` while a dragged item may land in it.

item.$description: An item that can be moved (`sortable`), and the one being dragged (`dragging`: left faint in its place).

line.$description: The line where a drop would land: its thickness is `height` (lying), its colour `bg`.

ghost.$description: The copy of the item after the pointer.
